title: Oura Temperature Deviation and Readiness Watch
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=oura:daily
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(temp_deviation_c) as temp_deviation_c, avg(readiness_score) as readiness_score by person _time
| where temp_deviation_c>0.5 AND readiness_score<70
| sort - temp_deviation_c
description: Uses Oura daily readiness telemetry to monitor temperature deviation paired with lower readiness in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for early warning days when recovery and body temperature both move the wrong way, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Oura daily readiness data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily scatter plot of temperature deviation and readiness.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers temperature deviation paired with lower readiness so you can spot early warning days when recovery and body temperature both move the wrong way before it becomes annoying.
